title: The tavern, named
logline: The tavern he lived behind for twenty years, drawn from the front for the first time. The name is on the sign. (The name is reserved: the page is drawn; the lettering waits.)

panels.composition: The cedar-shake tavern from the highway, April, morning, closed. Three trucks' worth of empty gravel. The beer sign off. The sign above the door, fully legible for the first time in twenty-eight years: [THE NAME]. WOOD from behind at the edge of the lot, looking at it like he's reading it for the first time, which he is not.

characters.pose: from behind at the lot's edge
